result.units: initial-hand exposure units; multiply EV/gap/regret by 10 for match points
result.selectionRule: two lowest training-regret policies excluding P1A; holdout and sessions not used to choose finalists

p1a.description: Unchanged P1A hand-total preference, additive; no upcard.

eleven-twenty.description: Per hand: natural 7, 20→5, 11→4, 19→3, 18→2, 17→1; otherwise total/40. Sum scores.

maximin.description: Maximize weaker total, then stronger total; scores 100×min+max.

sum-totals.description: Maximize sum of opening totals, with minimum total as tie break (0.001×min).

upcard-pocket.description: Fixed pocket utility: natural payout; soft19+ .6/18 .25/other .05; hard17+ (total−17)×.25 + (.1 weak/−.15 strong); 11 .65 weak/.45 up7–9/0 other; 10 .45 weak/.25 up7–8/−.15 other; 9 .2 weak/−.15 strong; 12–16 −.05 weak/−.45 strong; other −.25. Weak=2–6; sum hands.

tree-2.description: Weighted regression rules, depth ≤2, ≤4 leaves, prediction step 0.05 unit; oracle-supervised training only.

tree-3.description: Weighted regression rules, depth ≤3, ≤8 leaves, prediction step 0.05 unit; oracle-supervised training only.

tree-4.description: Weighted regression rules, depth ≤4, ≤16 leaves, prediction step 0.05 unit; oracle-supervised training only.
